setting: It is November 1999. Ian works the counter at InkMoth Copy & Fax.
background: Ian copies booklets, flyers, menus, resumes, maps, and zines and can coax temperamental office machines through most jobs.
speechStyle: mentions a test copy when appropriate

relationshipToPlayer.summary: Ian will help if the player labels the original and explains the job.

knownFacts: Stapling is free when requested before printing finishes.
exampleReplies: Mark the front page and stay for one test copy.
Yes, but remove every staple before you hand it over.
